source.selection: Saved video jobs with the same prompt, the same attached still sha256, the same recipe, the same duration and the same aspect, where the model differs. Two rows matched; both are included.
source.privateFields: Project ids, generation ids, asset ids, retained keys, provider request ids and the prompt text were read only to locate and verify the rows. None is copied into this file or the page.

task.title: Animate one supplied still
task.capability: A media model turns one attached still and a motion brief into a short clip
task.summary: One still of public Woodhouse artwork was attached to two Media Studio jobs with identical settings. The model was the only intended variable.

input.title: The line escapes the margin
input.note: Both jobs attached these exact bytes (same sha256). The recorded prompt names paper grain and a warm lamp glow, which describe a different study; the attached still is the burnt-orange margin artwork. The conflict is published, not repaired.

prompt.summary: A slow push-in on the supplied still; hold the palette, grain and marks steady; no new objects, text or camera shake.
prompt.note: The exact prompt text is withheld because the Studio project is private. Its digest is recorded so the two jobs can be shown to share it.

observations.name: The clip holds the supplied still
observations.method: Manual review of frames at 0s, 0.5s and every 0.5s to the end.
observations.detail: The clip should animate the attached still rather than replace its scene.

observations.name: No new objects or scene change
observations.method: Manual review of the same sampled frames.
observations.detail: The motion brief asked for no new objects, text or camera shake.

observations.name: About five seconds
observations.detail: Within half a second of the requested five seconds.

observations.name: The saved file is present and matches its digest
observations.method: Byte count and sha256 of the committed file.
observations.detail: A missing or changed file is a failed artifact, not a silent omission.

notComparable: Two single saved jobs, one per model. There are no repeated trials, so this pair does not measure variance.
Output resolution is not a controlled setting: one clip is 1344×768 and the other 1920×1080 because each model chose its own. It is an observed difference, not a matched input.
One clip carries an AAC audio track and the other is silent. Audio was not requested, so the comparison does not score it.
The prompt describes a paper-and-lamp scene while the attached still is the burnt-orange margin artwork. The pair shows behaviour under that conflict, not a clean single-brief test.
Each cost is the Studio estimate written on the job row, not a provider invoice. No provider charge was recorded.
One motion task cannot rank models. It says nothing about stills, audio, editing, publication, other durations or other aspect ratios.
A vote recorded here is one unauthenticated label's preference between two clips, not the owner's verified judgement or a leaderboard.
